chapter_00.title: The Next Generation
chapter_00.narrator_01: Once, we looked at the stars and wondered if we could ever reach them.
chapter_00.narrator_02: We imagined distant worlds, drew maps of the heavens, and dreamed of journeys beyond our own.
chapter_00.narrator_03: And little by little, those dreams became discoveries.
chapter_00.narrator_04: In a future not so far from our own, humanity was beginning to venture farther from Earth than ever before.
chapter_00.narrator_05: We built stations among the stars and established a lasting presence on the Moon.
chapter_00.narrator_06: And now, on the distant red plains of Mars, humanity was taking its first steps into a new world.
chapter_00.narrator_07: But every new frontier brought new challenges. The explorers of tomorrow would need knowledge, curiosity, and courage.
chapter_00.narrator_08: And somewhere on Earth, a new generation was already preparing to answer the call.

chapter_02.narrator_06: Mars slowly disappears into the distance. Somewhere beyond it, Vera's journey continues.
